1_information_fidelity.finding: DAG 4-node fixes (extract 6-category, merge lossless, verify annotate, report dual-input) raised Q from 0.06-0.17 to 0.43-0.70

2_model_complementarity.finding: DS excels at extract (Q=0.365, 5.6s); Qwen excels at merge/verify/report (Q=0.494-0.598, 33-42s)

3_conditional_decision.finding: Controller correctly selects NONE/R/π based on fault type: natural→no action, transient→R, persistent→R then π

4_R_vs_pi.finding: Transient anomaly: R sufficient (Q=0.394 both); Persistent anomaly: R fails (Q=0), π only recovery (Q=0.500)

5_pi_qwen_recovery.finding: In tested persistent node execution anomaly, same-model retry failed; switching to Qwen (different failure mode) recovered, terminal Q 0→0.35
5_pi_qwen_recovery.evidence: Real V2 anomaly replay + persistent injection; GLM fallback failed (thinking-token), Qwen succeeded
5_pi_qwen_recovery.note: Positive mechanism evidence for tested conditions; not claimed as universal for all persistent anomalies

joint_optimization_summary.conclusion: JointDynamic highest Q in both conditions; cost premium 9-12%; π is sole recovery for persistent anomalies
